messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

No change on order Shop···· yet. Your Magic M. 40T is paid and hasn't shipped, but there is news since your last chat. The 40T units have left the factory and are on their way to our US warehouses now. Your miner ships once that stock arrives and is checked in. Tracking goes to your email as soon as it leaves.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The team still has your request for a firm ship date and will reply by email.
